args.title: Juniper freight articles — combined summary
args.body:
Combined summary of blog.juniper.example/2026/freight and its subscriber companion piece (insights.juniper.example/freight/companion):

• Freight spot rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady.
• Fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices.
• Companion analysis: shippers who split volume across three carriers paid the least.
